meta.tower_convention: w/kappa readout = ONLINE density_b (build_pool, unchanged from eval_density_zeroshot.py); z_r reward embedding (E2a) and _density_z_encode candidates (E2b) = TARGET target_density_b -- spec 24 sec.1

readout.e2a: z_r = sqrt(d) * normalize( E_pool[ r(x) B_bar(x_tilde) ] ) -- spec 24 sec.3 E2a, gciql_flow._sphere norm convention
readout.e2b: candidates z(u_j) = agent._density_z_encode(u_j) for u_j ~ e2b_candidate_size pool samples; scored by pool PRIMARY Q_r(s0,.) (compute_density_primary/density_weights, imported unchanged); argmax selects z* -- spec 24 sec.3 E2b
readout.rollout: plain fixed-z rollout (sample_actions_with_z), no per-step re-scoring -- retrieval-decode-then-rollout shape shared with eval_density_zeroshot.py
readout.control: g-indexed retrieval decode (decode_goal_retrieval_density, imported unchanged from eval_density_zeroshot.py) over e2b_candidate_size dataset candidates -- NOT a z-construction at all; requires a measure_density_z=False checkpoint (check_control_consistency). Added 2026-08-13 so E2a/E2b's region_success_from_obs reads have a same-metric, same-families, same-pool g-indexed comparison point (the task's original .315/.242/.235 anchors are native env success, a DIFFERENT metric -- comparing E2 against them is a protocol mismatch).
readout.success: region_success_from_obs (imported unchanged) at the family's own reward center, uniformly across dirac/dense/region -- point-mass-maze's native env success is keyed to a DIFFERENT (env-internal task_id) goal, so the manipspace shortcut of using info['success'] does not apply here
